purpose: method-independent IEEE9 six-duration EIG space sweep
selection_rule: adaptive_gap_lcb95>0 AND nonmyopic_gap_lcb95>0 AND meaningful_branches>=2 AND meaningful_duration_branches>=2 AND dominant_duration_share<=0.8 AND lookahead_duration!=myopic_duration for every seed
no_pass_action: Do not choose a least-bad set; run a full-grid candidate search or redesign observations/actions.
